experimental_6p2.description: Measured 11-layer DFXM orientation volume at 6.2% strain.
permitted_use: report measured domain descriptors with acquisition and parameter provenance
demonstrate qualitative behaviour on real data
prohibited_use: serve as ground truth for method ranking
experimental_6p2.status: deferred; existing 3411/1811 and 1129/941 result chains must be reconciled before reuse

synthetic_primary.description: Fixed 360-cell synthetic three-dimensional orientation field motivated by approximately 6% strain.
permitted_use: compare size-ordered, unordered, and pure-KAM identification
quantify cell-count, identity, partition, and boundary errors
prohibited_use: reuse experimental domain counts as synthetic truth

synthetic_strain_suite.description: Independent labelled phantoms spanning 2.4%, 3.5%, 4.6%, and 6.2% strain proxies and three difficulty levels.
permitted_use: test transfer beyond the fixed primary phantom
support claims about the represented class of orientation fields
synthetic_strain_suite.status: held-out validation evidence; not the primary parameter-selection dataset

paper_policy.boundary_role: quantify uncertainty after count and identity selection; do not use as the primary selection criterion
paper_policy.synthetic_claim_scope: three-dimensional orientation fields with weak or incomplete interfaces and intradomain variation represented by the phantoms
